messages:
sara_sales: Quick question — pulling together a quote for E-432 (POC -> reserved commit). Quote created today. Which rate card version should I use? Legal is asking whether we can grandfather if LOI signed before the new rate card goes live.

aj_dealdesk: short answer: if the LOI or order form is executed before the effective date we can honor the prior published rate card. Need fully executed signature + finance acceptance. Also must use the ratecard_id on the SOW.

sara_sales: perfect — new rate card v3 drops on 2026-04-01 per the notes I saw. If we sign 03/30 but finance processes 04/02 does that violate the rule?

nisha_pricing: we treat the signature date on the order form as the authoritative date. Finance processing date doesn't move the grandfathering. That said, quotes must not be backdated; include the ratecard_id that was current when signed.

mike_eng: tagging on dedicated capacity: operationally, commits that reference older ratecard might require us to confirm GPU capacity availability. If the quota was sized under old pricing assumptions we may need a short lead for provisioning. For E-432 what's the desired start date?

sara_sales: customer wants October start (long lead). This is primarily a pricing/version gating question now.

alice_cs: small FYI — our quoting tool (CRM) has a ratecard field. Please set ratecard_id exactly as shown in internal docs, otherwise downstream billing breaks. Example in config:
```
quote:
  ratecard_id: "RC-2025-11"
  expires_at: "2026-04-30"
```

sara_sales: got it. If LOI is signed before 04/01 and we put RC-2025-11 on the form, we can proceed and finance will bill at those rates?

aj_dealdesk: yes. Also note: if customer requests product add-ons after the effective date, additional lines will be priced at the newer ratecard unless explicitly listed on the original order form. We sometimes use a 'locked-line' approach for fixed items, but must be explicitly enumerated.

nisha_pricing: additional nuance: discount overrides tied to deal desk approvals do not auto-carry between ratecards. If the deal had an approved special discount under v2, we need an annotation in the SOW to carry it forward, and Deal Desk needs to re-approve if more than 90 days pass.

sara_sales: ok — E-432 has a one-off 15% enterprise discount. Should I attach the approval to the SOW now to avoid re-approval?

aj_dealdesk: yes please. Attach the approval doc and include approver name and timestamp. We'll also add a note in the ratecard-change log that this deal is grandfathered.

ratecard_bot: :memo: Ratecard v3 (RC-2026-04) published internally: https://redwood.internal/docs/ratecards/RC-2026-04 — effective 2026-04-01. See change log for mapping of legacy IDs.

sara_sales: thanks all. I'll get the LOI out this afternoon and flag the ratecard_id and approval. If anything changes I'll ping here.

aj_dealdesk: thanks — I'll update the internal matrix and send a short note to #sales-all summarizing the grandfathering rules and CRM field guidance. :thumbsup:
